english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a horse-drawn carriage.
This is the all-purpose choice for a horse-drawn ceremonial or pleasure carriage when battle is not the focus.
Use this for the all-purpose horse-drawn vehicle, including a wagon used to carry goods.

examples.english: We took a carriage to visit the castle.
examples.traditional: 我哋坐馬車去參觀城堡。

examples.english: We took a chariot around the old city, and it felt romantic.
